ARCS kitMolecule 58toast

Toast

Keep the one standing guard of a page in view (a stop-loss, a limit) without putting it in the reading order twice, and let the reader dismiss it for the session.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1FrameFixed bottom right, elevated surface, border in its one meaningelevated, gold (limit) or red (failed check)
2TitleMono caps at the label step, in the frame's colourgold, red
3CloseA 44px icon button labelled Dismiss; Escape also closes ittext-secondary, hover cyan
4MessageThe guard itself, one or two sentencestext
5MetaWhen it was set and by whattext-secondary

Usage

Use it when

  • A page has exactly one guard the reader must not lose while scrolling.
  • The guard is already decided; the toast reminds, it does not ask.

Do not use it when

  • Do not stack toasts; a second guard belongs in the page.
  • Do not use red for a limit. Colour has one meaning across the kit (arc weld spec 4.3): red a failed check, gold a limit, green proven, cyan an action or focus, plain (steel) unknown, magenta a paradox.
  • Do not put an action that sends or publishes in a toast.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
tonegold | redyesgold for a limit, red only for a failed check.
title, msg, metastringyesmeta names the time and what set the guard.

Access

  • role="status", so it is announced once and does not steal focus.
  • The close button has an aria-label; Escape closes it; the dismissal is kept for the session only, and the page still works with storage blocked.
  • Reduced motion drops the slide in. Print places it in the flow at the end of the page.
